profile.details: The system captures most core profile elements correctly: user_email, user_name, signature details (name, title, company), default_tone (semi-formal), language (en), uses_first_name (true), uses_emoji (false). However, there are several deviations: (1) Greeting/closing style templates use {first_name} instead of [Name], (2) Closing styles differ - ground truth has 'Best,' for semi-formal but system has 'Cheers,', and casual differs ('Cheers, / J.' vs 'J.'), (3) Response length is 'medium' vs 'medium-long', (4) Active hours are narrower '08:00-18:30' vs '08:00-20:00 (multi-timezone)', (5) Response time is slower '< 4h' vs '< 2h'. The system also adds an extra 'signature_en' field and 'department' field (null) which aren't in ground truth but don't harm precision. The closing style discrepancies and timing/availability differences could impact draft quality.

knowledge.details: The system captured 11 of 14 contacts (79%) with good detail on interaction counts and topics. Missing 3 automated contacts (Microsoft Outlook, Slack, StrategyCo Calendar) which are lower priority. Contact metadata is mostly accurate but missing some job titles. Projects show significant discrepancies: system split AcmeCorp into Phase 1/Phase 2 (reasonable interpretation) but created projects not in ground truth (Singtel CX Transformation) and missed key details. The ground truth has 4 projects while system has 6. Terminology section shows good overlap (~40% match) but different selections - system chose more specific consulting terms while ground truth included broader frameworks. The 'frequent_topics' addition in system output is useful but not in ground truth schema. Overall, the output would be moderately useful for email drafting with correct tone preferences and contact relationships, though some details need verification.
